text: @lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder 是面向 DSH Web 与 Desktop profile 的 Qoder CN 模型提供方插件。它向 DSH 注册 qoder-cn 路由，并在 Models 设置页提供连接卡片。插件可发现 Qoder 在线模型目录或使用静态目录，发送流式生成请求，转换文本、推理、工具调用和图像输入，并支持企业 VPC 端点及连接参数编辑。适合需要在 DSH 中调用 Qoder CN 模型的用户；使用前需配置 Qoder PAT。

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder connects DSH to Qoder CN. It registers a qoder-cn model route and adds a Models settings card. It discovers models or uses a static catalog, streams text, reasoning and tool calls, supports image inputs, and allows enterprise VPC endpoints. A Qoder PAT is required.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder 的功能「模型目录发现」：未配置静态 models 时，插件通过 Qoder CN 获取启用模型并映射模型标识、名称、上下文和输入模态；也可用配置目录完整替代在线发现。
@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder 的功能「流式模型生成」：选择 qoder-cn 模型后，插件将 DSH 消息和工具定义转换为 Qoder 请求并读取 SSE 流，逐步返回文本、推理、工具调用及用量结果。
@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder 的功能「连接设置卡片」：在 Models 页面底部卡片编辑 PAT、VPC 实例和高级网关地址；提交时更新配置并将 PAT 存入 DSH credentials 服务。
@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder 的功能「图像输入模型支持」：在线模型目录标记支持视觉输入的模型为 text 与 image 模态，供 DSH 按模型能力选择图像输入。

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · @lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder：Qoder CN adapter plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Installs the `qoder-cn` provider route: COSY-signed, WAF-encoded streaming against `gateway.qoder.com.cn`. A Qoder PAT (`pt-...`) is stored through the Models page and exchanged per process for a short-lived job token.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.1` or newer in the `0.2.x` line and pnpm. Verified against the official `0.2.1-alpha.2` runtime.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder
dsh web
```

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：Open **Settings → Models → Qoder CN → Edit connection**. This card ships with the plugin and uses the official Models-page extension slot; no Harness source patch is required. Enter a PAT, and optionally an enterprise VPC instance ID. Leave the instance empty for the public CN cloud. Advanced settings allow explicit Gateway and OpenAPI URLs.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：The card never reads back the PAT. Leaving its input empty preserves the existing credential; environment-owned credentials are read-only. Connection changes take effect on the next request. If configuration saves but credential storage fails, the card keeps the token draft and reports the partial save for retry. A stale configuration revision is rejected before writing a token.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：The unscoped npm package `dsh-provider-qoder` belongs to a different project. This implementation is published as `@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder`; `github:minglu6/dsh-provider-qoder` remains an alternative source. To link a local checkout after building:

```sh
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web link /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-qoder
```

Restart the Web profile after installing or rebuilding the plugin's browser bundle.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：For Desktop, fully quit the application and replace `--profile web` with `--profile desktop`. When migrating this implementation from an older GitHub/tarball install named `dsh-provider-qoder`, replace that dependency and its `dsh.profile.bundles` entry with the scoped name; also update the existing `llm-qoder` entry's package `name` to `@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder`. Preserve that entry's connection configuration, credential references, and all credential storage. Do not load both names at once.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Install：Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder
```

From a DeepSeek Harness checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder
pnpm dsh web
```

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Config：The bundle mounts the `llm-qoder` entry. Its live configuration is persisted through DSH's profile `cordis.patch.yml`, and PATs are stored through the DSH credentials service. The default credential reference is `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`; a launch environment can supply that reference instead.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Config：An existing `providers.qoder-cn` profile overrides only the fields it declares and inherits other root fields. The card edits that profile when present, otherwise the root. An explicit empty VPC instance selects public cloud instead of an inherited or environment-provided tenant. Empty URL overrides derive endpoints from the selected VPC or public cloud. Advanced configuration and model overrides not edited by the card are preserved.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Config：Unless `models` is configured, the adapter fetches Qoder's signed live catalog from `/algo/api/v2/model/list` whenever DSH lists the provider. Model IDs are the upstream `key`, and labels are the upstream `display_name` (or the key when no name is supplied). Generation sends that same key unchanged in its headers and body. Distinct keys remain distinct even when their display names match.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Config：Exact-model resolution reuses the latest successful catalog in the current process. The DSH browser also caches its model selector catalog: opening the menu repeatedly does not poll Qoder. Reload the page to request a fresh catalog, or let settings, credentials, or adapter changes trigger its refresh.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Config：`models` remains an optional complete static override for deployments that intentionally pin the selector catalog. Every configured `id` must be an upstream wire key. This list replaces live discovery rather than extending it. Authentication failures surface as `AUTH` (and a rejected job-token session is dropped and retried once after a fresh exchange), transport, invalid JSON, and empty-catalog failures surface as discovery errors instead of falling back to a built-in list.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Model-ID migration：Saved selections or static catalogs using versioned aliases such as `qwen3.6-flash`, `kimi-k2.6`, or `glm-5.2` must be reselected from the live directory or changed to the intended upstream key. Do not infer the key from an old version label: Qoder can rename or replace the model behind a key. `auto` is unchanged. Historical session logs are not rewritten. The `getQoderCNDirectModel` helper is no longer exported; callers send the selected upstream key directly.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Tool-call history compatibility：Qoder can reject tool results when the preceding assistant message contains only tool calls and has `content: null`. The adapter adds a non-empty `(tool call)` marker to that assistant message on the wire, preserving call IDs, arguments, result order, and stored session history. Existing text and reasoning remain unchanged. After installing the updated plugin and restarting the Host, affected conversations can be retried without rewriting their history.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Tool-call history compatibility：In-band upstream errors expose the nested provider message and gateway request ID rather than truncating the JSON wrapper before the actionable detail. Error classification and authentication retry behavior are unchanged.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Streaming reasoning and incomplete responses：The adapter incrementally recognizes `<thinking>`, `<think>`, `<reasoning>`, and `<thought>` across stream boundaries, even if upstream emits them with reasoning disabled. Ordinary text, whitespace, native reasoning, and structured tool calls are preserved.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Streaming reasoning and incomplete responses：A normal stop containing only reasoning, or unclosed tagged reasoning without a structured tool call, finishes with `QODER_INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE` rather than reporting success. Partial reasoning remains available as evidence; orphan DSML fragments are not converted into invented tool calls. Real tool calls and length-limit termination retain their normal behavior. This guard does not retry requests or replay tools.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Remote sessions and unsolicited checkpoints：Remote session identity is scoped to the gateway, account, provider route, model, harness `sessionId`, and request `purpose`. Compaction and session-title calls do not share the foreground conversation's remote session. Requests without a harness session get a fresh identity; request-record IDs also include the serialized messages, tools, prompt, and generation settings.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Remote sessions and unsolicited checkpoints：For ordinary conversations, the adapter quarantines the specific unsolicited `<analysis>…</analysis><summary>…</summary>` checkpoint scaffold containing at least three recognized English/Chinese checkpoint headings. Fragmented tags and Markdown quote separators are supported; ordinary XML examples and answers following a checkpoint are preserved. Quarantined output is not exposed as answer text, and generation is retried **once** with the original history/tools, a fresh remote session, and an instruction to complete the task. The adapter never executes or replays tools. Another checkpoint finishes with `QODER_UNEXPECTED_SUMMARY`, not a successful stop; upstream failures and cancellation retain their original semantics.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Remote sessions and unsolicited checkpoints：Harness requests explicitly marked `purpose: 'compaction'` or `'session-title'`, and user-requested summaries, bypass this output safeguard. DSH compaction can carry the foreground tool declarations, so tool presence is not used to identify it. The guard is not a general XML filter or a fix for the gateway's internal summarization behavior. Recovery may incur one additional model request.

@lightmanlu/dsh-provider-qoder README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run typecheck
```

The build emits the Host adapter and a lazy-CJS browser bundle under `dist/`. Both are included in the package and tracked for direct GitHub installation. The adapter accepts the official request-message format, including standalone `role: tool` results.
